paragraphs: Allegion plc ("Allegion," "we," "us" or "the Company") is a leading global provider of security products and solutions that keep people and assets safe and secure in the places they live, learn, work and connect. We pioneer safety and security to create a safer and more accessible world. Both developing and partnering are central to our work to create ecosystems that enable seamless access experiences and an uninterrupted and secure flow of people and assets. We offer an extensive and versatile portfolio of security and access control products and solutions across a range of market-leading brands. Our experts around the world deliver high-quality hardware, software, services and systems, and we use our deep expertise to serve as trusted partners to end-users who seek customized solutions to their security needs.
We offer the following extensive and versatile portfolio of security and access control products and solutions across a range of market-leading brands:

•Door controls, door control systems, and exit devices: An extensive portfolio of life-safety products and solutions generally installed on fire doors and facility entrances and exits. Exit devices, also known as panic hardware, provide rapid egress to allow building occupants to exit safely in an emergency. Door controls and systems include mechanical door closers, automatic door operators, as well as high-performance interior and storefront door systems. In addition, we offer a full range of automatic entrance solutions, including sliding, swing, folding and ICU doors, as well as an array of sensors, controls and security options for commercial and institutional buildings. Sold under leading brands like Briton®, CISA®, LCN®, STANLEY® Access Technologies ("Stanley Access Technologies" or "Stanley"; "STANLEY" is the property of Stanley Logistics L.L.C.) and Von Duprin®;

•Doors, glass and door systems, and accessories: A portfolio of hollow metal doors and frames, glass and specialty door systems, as well as a variety of additional security products and components, including hinges, door pulls, door stops, louvers, weather stripping, thresholds and other accessories. Sold under leading brands like Falcon®, Glynn-Johnson®, Ives®, Republic™, Steelcraft®, TGP® and Trimco®;

•Electronic security products and access control systems, including time, attendance and workforce productivity: A broad range of electronic locks, electronic door closers and exit devices, access control products and systems, credentials and credential readers and accessories, including Bluetooth Low Energy, Power over Ethernet and cloud-based solutions, including products designed to help business customers manage and monitor workforce access, attendance and employee scheduling. Sold under leading brands like Bricard®, CISA, ELATEC®, Interflex®, LCN, Schlage®, SimonsVoss® and Von Duprin;

•Locks, locksets, portable locks, and key systems: A broad array of cylindrical, tubular and mortice door locksets, security levers and master key systems that are used to protect and control access and a range of portable security products, including bicycle, small vehicle and travel locks. Sold under leading brands like Bricard, AXA, CISA, Falcon, Gainsborough®, Schlage and SimonsVoss; and

•Services and software: Our Stanley Access Technologies business offers extensive planned inspection, maintenance and repair services for its automatic entrance solutions throughout the U.S. and Canada. We offer ongoing aftermarket services and design and installation offerings in select locations. Additionally, we offer software as a service ("SaaS") offerings throughout the U.S. and internationally, including access control, platform integration and workforce management solutions through brands like Interflex, Yonomi® and Zentra® among others.

Security and access control products and solutions are critical elements in every building and home. Many door openings are configured to maximize a room's particular form and function while also meeting local and national building and safety code requirements and end-user security needs. Most buildings have multiple door openings, each serving its own purpose and requiring different specific access control solutions. Each door must fit exactly within its frame, be prepared precisely for its hinges, synchronize with its specific lockset and corresponding latch and align with a specific key to secure the door. Moreover, with the growing adoption of connected hardware and software solutions, security products – including credentials – are increasingly linked electronically, integrated into access control software and popular consumer technology platforms and controlled with mobile applications, creating additional functionality and complexity.
We believe our ability to deliver a wide range of solutions that can be custom configured to meet end-users' security needs is a key driver of our success. We accomplish this with:
•Our innovative, market-leading brands, many of which are known as pioneers in safety and / or invented their product categories, including: CISA, Interflex, LCN, Schlage, SimonsVoss and Von Duprin;

•Our extensive and versatile product and service portfolio, combined with our deep expertise, which enable us to deliver the right products and solutions to meet diverse security and functional specifications and to successfully and securely integrate into leading technologies and systems;

•Our consultative approach and expertise, which enable us to develop the most efficient and appropriate building security and access control specifications to fulfill the unique needs of our end-users and their partners, including architects, designers, security consultants, contractors, homebuilders and engineers;
•Our access to and management of key channels in the market, which is critical to delivering our products in an efficient and consistent manner; and

•Our enterprise excellence capabilities, including our global manufacturing operations and agile supply chain, which facilitate our ability to deliver specific product and system configurations to end-users and consumers worldwide, quickly and efficiently.

headings: Our business performance is impacted by the strength of the institutional, commercial and residential construction and remodeling markets and global macroeconomic factors.
Increased prices, whether due to inflationary pressures or other factors, could negatively impact our margin performance and our financial results.

Our global operations subject us to political, economic and regulatory risks, including uncertainty related to the imposition of new or increased tariffs and the global trade environment more generally.
Currency exchange rate fluctuations have had, and may continue to have, an adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.
We may be required to recognize impairment charges for our goodwill, indefinite-lived intangible assets and other long-lived assets.
The capital and credit markets are important to our business.
There are risks associated with our outstanding and future indebtedness.
Increased competition, including from technological developments, could adversely affect our business.
Our growth is dependent, in part, on the development, commercialization and acceptance of new products and services.
Changes in customer and consumer preferences and the inability to maintain beneficial relationships with large customers could adversely affect our business.
We may pursue business opportunities that diverge from our core business.
Our strategic initiatives, including enterprise excellence efforts among other significant capital expenditure projects, may not achieve the improvements or financial returns we expect.
We may not be able to effectively manage and implement restructuring initiatives or other organizational changes.
The effects of global climate change or other unexpected events, including global health crises, may disrupt our operations and have a negative impact on our business.

Our ability to successfully grow and expand our business depends on our ability to recruit and retain a highly qualified and diverse workforce.

We are subject to risks related to corporate social responsibility and reputational matters.
Our brands are important assets of our businesses, and violation of our trademark rights by imitators could negatively impact revenues and brand reputation.
Material legal judgments, fines, penalties or settlements imposed against us or our assets could adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows.

As a global business, we have a relatively complex tax structure, and there is a risk that tax authorities will disagree with our tax positions.
We could be subject to changes in tax rates, the adoption of new tax legislation or exposure to additional tax liabilities.
The implementation of global tax reforms could negatively impact our financial results.
Risks Related to Our Incorporation in Ireland

paragraphs: We are subject to future events, risks and uncertainties – many of which are beyond our control – that could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows. You should carefully consider the risk factors discussed below, together with all the other information included in this Form 10-K, in evaluating us and our securities. If any of the events, risks or uncertainties below actually occurs, our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows could be materially and adversely affected. Any such adverse effect may cause the trading price of our securities to decline, and as a result, you could lose all or part of your investment in us. Our business, financial condition, results of operations and cash flows may also be materially and adversely affected by events, risks and uncertainties not known to us or events, risks and uncertainties that we currently believe to be immaterial.

Demand for our security products and solutions relies on the institutional, commercial, and residential construction and remodeling markets, which are marked by cyclicality based on national, regional and local economic conditions, including consumer confidence and disposable income, corporate and government spending, work-from-home trends, availability of credit and demand for new housing and infrastructure. As a result, weakness or instability in one or more of these markets could

slow demand for new construction or remodeling projects and cause current and potential customers to delay or cancel capital projects or otherwise choose not to make purchases, which could negatively impact the demand for our products and solutions and result in declines in our revenues, profitability and cash flows. In the recent past, our business operations and performance were also impacted by global macroeconomic challenges, including supply chain disruptions and delays, material, electronic component and labor shortages, prolonged periods of cost inflation, and increased interest rates. Negative macroeconomic trends, future market disruptions or uncertainty related to potential changes to fiscal and monetary policy and/or trade policy, including the imposition, or threatened imposition, of tariffs and potential retaliatory trade restrictions, may make it more challenging for us to manufacture and deliver products to our customers, could cause periodic production interruptions and supply constraints, impact our ability to forecast and plan for future business activities and, if not adequately managed by us, could cause a material adverse impact on our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

Higher prices for raw materials, parts and components, freight, packaging, labor and energy, whether caused by inflationary pressures or other geopolitical factors, such as new or increased tariffs, duties, or other charges as a result of changes to U.S. or international trade policies or trade agreements, increase our costs to manufacture and distribute our products and services, and we may be unable to pass these increased costs on to our customers. We do not currently use financial derivatives to hedge against volatility in commodity prices; however, we utilize firm purchase commitments, where possible, to help mitigate risk. The pricing of some materials, parts and components we use is based on market prices. To mitigate this exposure, we may use annual price contracts to minimize the impact of inflation and to benefit from deflation. However, these hedging and pricing strategies may not fully protect us against cost increases caused by factors such as new or increased tariffs, changing import duties, market illiquidity and specific local regulations.

Additionally, we are exposed to fluctuations in other costs such as packaging, freight, labor and energy prices. If these costs increase beyond our ability to control for them through measures such as implementing operating efficiencies, or we are not able to increase prices to sufficiently offset the effect of various cost increases without negatively impacting customer demand, our margin performance and results of operations would be negatively impacted.

Our businesses operate around the world in various geographic regions and product markets. Additionally, we procure various products, parts, components and services from supplier partners located throughout the world. Our global operations depend on products manufactured, purchased and sold in the U.S. and internationally, including in Australia, Canada, China, Europe, Mexico, New Zealand and the Middle East. The political, economic and regulatory environments in which we operate are becoming increasingly volatile and uncertain. paragraphs: In 2025, we delivered high-single digit revenue growth compared to 2024, driven by favorable pricing and volume growth, as well as the impact from acquisitions made during the year. Demand for electronic security products has also remained strong and continues to be a long-term growth driver.

Throughout 2025, the U.S. government announced tariffs on imports from several countries from which we manufacture and/or import products and components. In 2025, we offset inflation due to tariffs with pricing actions. We continue to analyze the impact of changes in tariffs and what, if any, steps, including pricing actions, we may take to mitigate the impact of the tariffs. We estimate we source approximately 20-25% of cost of goods sold ("COGS") from Mexico, less than 5% of COGS from China, and 5-10% of COGS from all other non-US countries. Additionally, this could impact future demand.
The demand trends and macroeconomic conditions discussed above and a number of other challenges and uncertainties that could affect our businesses are described under Part I, Item 1A, "Risk Factors."

Allegion plc ("Allegion," "we," "us" or "the Company") 為全球領先的保安產品與解決方案供應商，專門提供保護人們與資產安全的產品與解決方案，應用於人們居住、學習、工作與連線的場所。我們致力於創新安全與保安技術，以創造更安全且更易接觸的世界。開發與合作為我們工作的核心，以建立能提供順暢通行體驗與持續且安全的通行與資產流動的生態系統。我們提供廣泛且靈活的保安與通行控制產品與解決方案，涵蓋多種市場領導品牌的產品。我們全球的專業團隊提供高品質的硬體、軟體、服務與系統，並運用我們深厚的專業知識，成為終端用戶尋求客製化安全解決方案的可信任夥伴。
我們提供以下廣泛且靈活的保安與通行控制產品與解決方案，涵蓋多種市場領導品牌的產品：

•門控系統、門控系統與出口裝置：提供廣泛的生安全產品與解決方案，通常安裝於防火門與設施入口與出口。出口裝置，也稱為恐慌裝置，可提供快速疏散功能，讓建築內的佔有人能在緊急情況下安全離開。門控系統與系統包括機械門關閉器、自動門操作器，以及高性能的內門與店面門系統。此外，我們還提供完整的自動入口解決方案，包括滑動門、轉門、摺疊門與ICU門，以及用於商業與機構建築的各種感測器、控制裝置與安全選項。產品銷售於如Briton®、CISA®、LCN®、STANLEY® Access Technologies ("Stanley Access Technologies" 或 "Stanley"; "STANLEY" 為 Stanley Logistics L.L.C. 所擁有) 以及 Von Duprin® 等領導品牌；
•門、玻璃與門系統，以及配件：提供空心金屬門與門框、玻璃與特殊門系統，以及多種其他安全產品與零組件，包括合頁、門把手、門止塊、百葉窗、氣密條、門檻與其他配件。產品銷售於如 Falcon®、Glynn-Johnson®、Ives®、Republic™、Steelcraft®、TGP® 以及 Trimco® 等領導品牌；

•電子安全產品與存取控制系統，包括時間、出勤與員工生產力管理：廣泛的電子鎖、電子門關閉器與出口裝置、存取控制產品與系統、憑證與讀取器及配件，包括藍牙低功耗、以太網供電與雲端解決方案，包括用於協助企業客戶管理與監控員工存取、出勤與排班的產品。銷售於如 Bricard®、CISA、ELATEC®、Interflex®、LCN、Schlage®、SimonsVoss® 和 Von Duprin 等領導品牌下；
•鎖、鎖具、便攜鎖與鑰匙系統：廣泛的圓柱形、管狀與-mortice 門鎖具、安全把手與主鑰匙系統，用於保護與控制存取，以及一系列便攜安全產品，包括自行車、小型車輛與旅行鎖。銷售於如 Bricard、AXA、CISA、Falcon、Gainsborough®、Schlage 和 SimonsVoss 等領導品牌下；

•服務與軟體：我們的 Stanley Access Technologies 事業提供廣泛的預定檢查、維護與修理服務，用於其自動入口解決方案於美國與加拿大全境。我們提供持續的後市場服務，並在部分地區提供設計與安裝服務。此外，我們於美國與國際市場提供軟體即服務（"SaaS"）解決方案，包括存取控制、平台整合與員工管理解決方案，透過如 Interflex、Yonomi® 和 Zentra® 等品牌及其他品牌。

安全與存取控制產品與解決方案是每座建築與住宅的關鍵要素。許多門口設計用以最大化房間的特定形狀與功能，同時也符合當地與國家建築與安全規範及終端用戶的安全需求。大多數建築都有多個門口，每個門口都有其特定用途，並需要不同的存取控制解決方案。每個門必須精確地配合其門框、準確準備其合頁、與其特定鎖具及對應的鈕扣同步，並與特定鑰匙對齊以確保門的安全。此外，隨著連接硬體與軟體解決方案的廣泛採用，安全產品 – 包括憑證 – 逐漸透過電子方式連結，整合至存取控制軟體與流行的消費者科技平台，並透過行動應用程式進行控制，創造出額外的功能與複雜性。
我們認為，我們能提供廣泛的解決方案，並可根據終端用戶的保安需求進行客製化配置，是我們成功的主要驅動因素。我們透過以下方式實現此目標：
• 我們創新且市場領先的品牌，其中許多被視為安全領域的先驅，或發明瞭其產品類別，包括：CISA、Interflex、LCN、Schlage、SimonsVoss 和 Von Duprin；
• 我們廣泛且靈活的產品與服務組合，結合我們深厚的專業知識，使我們能夠提供符合多樣化保安與功能規格的正確產品與解決方案，並成功且安全地整合至領先的技術與系統；
• 我們的諮詢式方法與專業知識，使我們能夠開發最有效且適當的建築保安與存取控制規格，以滿足終端用戶及其合作夥伴（包括建築師、設計師、保安顧問、承包商、住宅建商與工程師）的獨特需求；
• 我們對市場關鍵通路的接觸與管理，對於以高效且一致的方式交付產品至終端用戶至關重要；以及
• 我們企業卓越的執行能力，包括全球製造作業與靈活的供應鏈，使我們能夠迅速且高效地向全球終端用戶與消費者交付特定的產品與系統配置。

paragraphs: 2025 年，本公司實現高單位數的營業收入成長，相較於 2024 年，主要受益於有利的定價及銷售量成長，以及當年所進行的併購活動之影響。電子安全產品之需求亦持續強勁，並繼續作為長期成長動力。

2025 年期間，美國政府對來自本公司製造及/或進口產品與零組件之多個國家課徵關稅。2025 年，本公司透過定價措施抵銷因關稅所致的通貨膨脹。本公司持續分析關稅變動之影響，以及是否採取包括定價措施在內之相關措施，以緩解關稅之影響。本公司估計，我們約 20-25% 的成本費用（"COGS"）來自墨西哥，少於 5% 的 COGS 來自中國，以及 5-10% 的 COGS 來自所有其他非美國國家。此外，這可能會影響未來需求。
上述之需求趨勢與總體經濟條件，以及若干可能影響本公司業務之挑戰與不確定性，於第一部分，第 1A 項 "風險因素" 中有進一步說明。

headings: 本公司營運表現受機構、商業及住宅建設與裝修市場強弱及全球總體經濟因素影響。
價格上漲，無論是因通貨膨脹壓力或其他因素，都可能對本公司毛利率表現及財務結果產生負面影響。
本公司全球營運使其面臨政治、經濟及法規風險，包括因新或提高關稅及全球貿易環境所產生的不確定性。
貨幣兌換率波動已對本公司營運、財務狀況、營運成果及現金流產生負面影響，並可能持續產生。
本公司可能需認列 goodwill、無限期壽命無形資產及其他長期資產之減損費用。
資本及信用市場對本公司營運至關重要。
本公司現有及未來負債可能伴隨相關風險。
競爭增加，包括來自科技發展的競爭，可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們的成長部分取決於新產品與服務的開發、商業化及被接受程度。
客戶與消費者偏好變動，以及無法維持與大型客戶的有利關係，可能對我們的業務產生不利影響。
我們可能追求與核心業務不同的商業機會。
我們的策略性計劃，包括企業卓越計劃及其他重大資本支出項目，可能無法達到預期的改善或財務回報。
我們可能無法有效地管理與執行重整計劃或其他組織變革。
全球氣候變遷或其他未預期事件，包括全球健康危機，可能幹擾我們的運營並對我們的業務產生負面影響。
我們可能面臨與資訊科技及運營科技系統故障或中斷相關的風險。
網路安全事件可能幹擾業務運作，導致關鍵及機密資訊遺失，並對本公司的聲譽、營運成果及財務狀況造成不利影響。
我們面臨與遵守資料隱私權及治理法規相關的風險。
我們成功擴張業務的能力，取決於我們招募及留住高素質且多元化的員工的能力。
全球供應鏈的中斷，包括由我們供應商夥伴提供的產品製造及物流服務，可能對我們的業務造成負面影響。
我們面臨與企業社會責任及聲譽事項相關的風險。
我們的品牌是我們業務的重要資產，若仿冒者違反我們的商標權，可能對營收及品牌聲譽造成負面影響。
重大法律判決、罰款、處罰或對我們或我們資產的和解，可能對我們的業務、財務狀況、營運結果及現金流產生不利影響。
有人聲稱我們侵權第三方的智慧財產權，可能對我們產生負面影響。
我們的聲譽、營運能力及營運結果可能因任何員工、代理人或商業夥伴的不當行為而受到損害。
我們的營運受到與國內外環境、健康及安全法規相關的監管風險影響。
作為一家全球性企業，我們的稅務結構相對複雜，稅務機關可能不同意我們的稅務立場。
我們可能受到稅率變動、新稅法的採用或額外稅務負擔的影響。
全球稅務改革的實施可能對我們的財務結果產生負面影響。
與我們在愛爾蘭設立公司的相關風險
愛爾蘭法律與美國現行法律有所不同，可能對本公司證券持有人提供較少的保障。
paragraphs: 本公司面臨未來事件、風險與不確定性 – 其中許多為本公司所無法控制 – 這些事件、風險與不確定性可能對本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流造成重大且不利的影響。您應仔細考量下列所討論的風險因素，並配合本Form 10-K 所包含的所有其他資訊，以評估本公司及其證券。若下列任何事件、風險或不確定性實際發生，本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流可能受到重大且不利的影響。任何此類不利影響可能導致本公司證券交易價格下跌，進而使您可能損失全部或部分對本公司的投資。本公司業務、財務狀況、營運成果與現金流也可能因未知事件、風險與不確定性，或本公司目前認為不重要的事件、風險與不確定性而受到重大且不利的影響。
我們安全產品與解決方案的銷售需求取決於機構、商業與住宅建設與翻修市場，這些市場因國家、區域與地方經濟狀況而呈現週期性，包括消費者信心與可支配所得、企業與政府支出、遠端辦公趨勢、信貸可取得性與新住宅與基礎建設需求。因此，若這些市場中之一或數個出現弱勢或不穩定，將

減緩對新建設或翻修專案的需求，並導致現有與潛在客戶延後或取消資本專案，或選擇不進行購買，這可能對我們產品與解決方案的需求造成負面影響，並導致我們收入、利潤率與現金流下降。近期，本公司業務運作與表現亦受到全球總體經濟挑戰的影響，包括供應鏈中斷與延誤、原材料、電子零組件與勞動力短缺、長期成本膨脹與利率上升。負面總體經濟趨勢、未來市場中斷或與潛在財政與貨幣政策及/或貿易政策變動相關的不確定性，包括課徵或威脅課徵關稅與潛在貿易限制措施，可能使我們更難製造與交付產品給客戶，可能導致定期生產中斷與供應限制，影響我們預測與規劃未來業務活動的能力，若未被本公司妥善管理，可能對本公司業務、營運成果、財務狀況與現金流造成重大不利影響。

原材料、零件與零組件、運輸、包裝、勞動與能源價格的上升，無論是由通貨膨脹壓力或其他地緣政治因素所導致，例如因美國或國際貿易政策或貿易協議變動而產生的新或增加關稅、稅費或其他費用，將提高我們製造與分銷產品與服務的成本，我們可能無法將這些增加的成本轉嫁給客戶。目前，本公司未使用財務衍生工具來對抗商品價格波動；然而，我們在可能的情況下，會利用固定採購承諾來協助降低風險。我們使用的一些材料、零件與零組件的價格基於市場價格。為降低此風險，我們可能使用年度價格合約來減少通貨膨脹的影響，並從通貨收縮中受益。然而，這些避險與價格策略可能無法完全保護我們免於因新或增加關稅、變動進口稅、市場流動性不足與特定地方規範等因素所導致的成本上升。
此外，我們也面臨其他成本的波動，例如包裝、運輸、勞動與能源價格。若這些成本的上升超出我們透過實施運營效率等措施所能控制的範圍，或我們無法提高價格以足夠抵銷各種成本上升的影響，而不對客戶需求造成負面影響，則我們的毛利率表現與營運成果將受到負面影響。
本公司業務在全球各個地理區域與產品市場運作。此外，本公司從世界各地的供應商夥伴處採購各種產品、零件、零組件與服務。本公司全球運作依賴於美國與國際上製造、購買與銷售的產品，包括澳洲、加拿大、中國、歐洲、墨西哥、紐西蘭與中東等地。我們運作的政經與法規環境正變得越來越不穩定與不確定。因此，我們面臨多種風險，這些風險源自於全球運作與採購的內在特性，包括：
